playback: Play each row left to right and loop. Column 0=left-foot stride, 1=passing A, 2=right-foot stride, 3=passing B. Right-facing frames are a horizontal flip of left. Feet share one baseline with no walk bob.
alignment: Foot-midpoint centered on x=128. All frames share one baseline (no bob).

fix_notes.body: Programmatic horizontal widen (~25–35% mid-torso, milder shoulders) of the v2.8 2.2-head set. Faces and hair composited from the original. Agents are no longer specially slim.
fix_notes.left: Widened hem-locked side cycle, opposite arm swing (left foot forward ⇒ right/far arm forward; pass frames hang), packed at the same body height as front/back, hem/jacket-to-leg cuts closed only where garment sits above a leg (stride gap left open).
fix_notes.down: Widened the v2.8 foot-swap down frames; light opposite silhouette shift on stride frames when the arm shell is clean.
fix_notes.up: Widened the v2.8 foot-swap up frames, with the same light front/back arm shift when clean.
